2A)         It is required to design a digital system with the operations shown in Table P.2A  
  
  
  There are four registers R0 to R3 in the system which are connected to the bus through tri state  
  drivers. External data can be loaded into the registers from the Data input, which is connected to  
  the bus using tri state drivers enabled by the Extern control signal. The system also includes a  
  subtractor unit. One of its data inputs is provided by a register A, that is attached to the bus, while (5)  
  the other data input B, is directly connected to the bus. It also has a temporary output register G.  
  The operation is initiated by setting an input w to 1, and the control circuit asserts the Done output  
  when the operation is completed.  
  i) Draw the block diagram for this system  
  ii) Determine the timing signals required.  
  iii) Design the control circuit.  
  iv) Tabulate the necessary control signals required in different timings.  
  v) Derive the expressions for the outputs of the control circuit in terms of operations and timing  
  signals  
  
2B)         Design the least cost implementation with 2:1 multiplexer and other necessary gates for the  
  following function using Shannon's expansion:                                                          (3)  
  $$F(a,b,c,d) = abc + a'cd' + bcd$$  
  
2C)         Construct a Johnson counter which generates 6 timing signals. Write the count sequence and AND  
  gates required for the output.                                                                 (2)  
  
3A)         Develop the expressions for the flip flop inputs in the design of a counter with the following  
  repeated binary sequence: 0,1,2,4,5,6,7. Use JK flip-flops. Treat unused states as don't care          (5)  
  conditions. Analyze the counter to check if it is self-correcting or not.  
  
3B)         Distinguish between blocking and non-blocking assignments in Verilog. Draw the circuits for the        (3)  
  following codes.

module example5_5 (x1, x2, x3, Clk, f, g, h);

$$f=xl ~& x2;$$  
$$g=f-| x3;$$  
$$h=g/f$$  
end  
endmodule

$$f<=x1 ~& x2;$$
